title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.23236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks. Existing input-side defenses rely on trusted collection or local token perturbation, often disrupting the inter-item semantic topology needed for recommendation. To address it, we introduce relational fidelity as the key objective, requiring semantic shift for privacy while preserving relative item relations for utility. Based on this principle, we propose prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO), which learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and propagates them through a static semantic graph. PGPO is optimized with GRPO using individual dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraint rewards. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong inversion defense with near-upper-bound recommendation performance. The

translated_title: PGPO：面向隐私保护LLM增强推荐的原型引导渐进式混淆
translated_abstract: LLM增强的推荐系统将物品的辅助信息编码为语义嵌入，但这些嵌入可能通过反演攻击泄露敏感的文本属性。现有的输入侧防御依赖于可信收集或局部词元扰动，往往会破坏推荐所需的物品间语义拓扑结构。为解决这一问题，我们引入关系保真度作为关键目标，要求在实现隐私保护的语义偏移的同时，保留物品间的相对关系以维持推荐效用。基于这一原则，我们提出了原型引导的渐进式混淆（PGPO），该方法为高影响力的原型词学习拓扑感知的混淆锚点，并通过静态语义图进行传播。PGPO使用GRPO进行优化，采用个体差异性、结构一致性和语义约束三种奖励。在两个基准数据集上的实验表明，PGPO在实现强大反演攻击防御的同时，推荐性能接近上限。
tldr: 该论文提出PGPO方法，通过为高影响力原型词学习拓扑感知的混淆锚点并在静态语义图中渐进传播，在有效防御嵌入反演攻击保护隐私的同时保持物品间语义关系，实现接近上限的推荐性能。
en_tdlr: PGPO learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and progressively propagates them through a static semantic graph, achieving strong defense against embedding inversion attacks while preserving inter-item semantic relations for near-upper-bound recommendation performance.
